in_hebrew.name: ושנגתון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Washington comes from the Old English ‘weoh-washing-tun’ which can be broken down into ‘weoh’ (God) + ‘washing’ + ‘tun’ (enclosure or settlement). The name translates to ‘the help of God’ or ‘God’s protection’. This name is not directly from the Bible, but it embodies the idea of trusting in God for help and protection.

in_greek.name: Ουασινγτόν
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Washington does not have a direct translation in Greek, as it is of English origin. However, the meaning of the name – ‘the help of God’ or ‘God’s protection’ – can be expressed in Greek as ου σας αφίενται τον Θεόν (ou sas aphientai ton Theon), which means ‘God does not abandon you’.

in_latin.name: Washingtonius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Washington in Latin is derived from the Old English name and can be translated to ‘Washingtonius’ – ‘assistance from Jupiter’. This is due to the misconception that the name was derived from the Latin ‘wad’ (water) and ‘sanctus’ (holy), leading to the belief that it meant ‘holy water’. However, the true meaning of the name is ‘the help of God’ or ‘God’s protection’.
